Reminder: whoever is the next non-Republican president must routinely talk about running for more than two terms, and any Republican official who makes the slightest upset noise about that shall be dutifully launched into the sun

When they go low, we make them bite the curb

Maybe try that in the next DNC speech

The reason people keep yelling at the Dems to "DO SOMETHING" is because you can toss a stone in any direction in this country and it’ll land somewhere that elected Republicans are merrily rolling back people’s rights through the subversion of what few "norms" may have kept this country afloat

The three dissenting justices have the goods:
"...today the majority has broadened the meaning of the word 'election,' as used in the Virginia Constitution, to include the early voting period.  This is in direct conflict with how both Virginia and federal law define an election."

It’s wild to see TN lawmakers laughing in the faces of the Black representatives they’ve procedurally removed without voter input while VA’s Supreme Court strikes down a voter approved change

It’s all bullshit to be sure, but it’d be deeply unserious to deny the seemingly endless cynical fuckery
Hot tip: sleep soundly
